# Label fonts

- `LiberationSans-Regular.ttf` — Liberation Sans 2.1.5, SIL Open Font License 1.1 (https://scripts.sil.org/OFL).
  Metric-compatible with Arial; used for characters the label font lacks (e.g. "←" on drip labels), the way
  Windows substitutes a font for them.
- `Hacen-Eltaroute-Text.ttf` — **not in the repository** (HacenType, all rights reserved). The legacy labels use it.
  Copy it here from the label PC (`C:\Users\<user>\AppData\Local\Microsoft\Windows\Fonts\Hacen-Eltaroute-Text.ttf`,
  or `local-only\fonts` of a label capture) before building the app. It is gitignored.
